people.name: Duane Keith Davis
people.role: Former South Side Compton Crips figure; uncle of Orlando Anderson; the only person ever charged in Shakur's killing

history.detail: Recorded proffer interview with LAPD-federal task force: said he was in the Cadillac's front seat, passed a gun to the back seat, named Anderson as shooter (C19, C20). Date per one source; 'late December 2008' per another.
BET 'Death Row Chronicles': said shots came from the back seat; declined to name shooter (C22).
Memoir 'Compton Street Legend' places him in the Cadillac (C25).
LVMPD search warrant served at Henderson home (C31).
Clark County grand jury: open murder with use of a deadly weapon, gang enhancement (C35). Announced 29 Sept.
Arrested near his Henderson home (C34).
Pleaded not guilty; State not seeking death penalty (C39).
$750,000 bail with possible house arrest set (C41).
Judge Kierny refused release on the bail money offered (C41). Remains in custody (C43).
Motion to dismiss (immunity, 27-year delay) denied (C30).
Petition to Nevada Supreme Court to dismiss; outcome not found (C45).
2008 interview and memoir ruled admissible (C47).
Opening statements (C48).
Did not testify; defence rested (C58).
Jury verdict: first-degree murder with use of a deadly weapon, single count (C62). Gang enhancement reported dropped (C61, disputed).
Faces up to life without parole (C67). Not yet sentenced as of 2026-10-11.

matters.notes: Convicted, not yet sentenced. Prosecutors never alleged he fired the shots. He now says he is innocent and was not in Las Vegas (C66) and intends to appeal (C65). Re-check status on/after 13 Oct 2026.

matters.matter: December 2024 jail altercation, Clark County Detention Center

history.detail: Jury: battery by a prisoner; challenge to fight (C46).
16 to 40 months, plus concurrent 364 days (C46).

matters.notes: Separate matter. He says he was attacked. A new-trial motion was filed in April 2025; outcome not found.

people.name: Tupac Shakur
people.role: Rapper; victim

history.detail: Shot in Knight's BMW at Flamingo Rd / Koval Ln (C01-C04).
Died at University Medical Center (C07).

matters.notes: Earlier that night he was involved in the MGM Grand lobby fight with Anderson (C09).

people.name: Orlando Anderson
people.role: Davis's nephew; South Side Compton Crips associate

history.detail: Beaten in the MGM Grand lobby fight hours before the shooting (C09).
Named in a Compton police affidavit (Det. Tim Brennan); date not verified (C13).
Denied involvement, incl. to the Los Angeles Times (C14).
Killed in an unrelated shooting; 29 May 1998 and Compton vs Willowbrook not settled (C15).
Davis told investigators Anderson fired the shots (C20) - Davis's claim only.

matters.notes: Never charged; died with no court finding; consistently denied involvement. Never call him the killer. Police/prosecution have said they believe he fired (C13); Knight said he did not (C56, do not use).

history.detail: Caught on hotel cameras (C09).

people.name: Marion Knight
people.role: Death Row Records co-founder; driver of the BMW

history.detail: Driving the BMW; slightly wounded; released next day (C02, C06).
Said from prison he would not testify ('1000% I wouldn't go') (C55).
On the prosecution witness list; never called (C55).

matters.notes: Never charged in Shakur's killing (Davis is the only person ever charged, C11). Defence evidence about vehicles at his home (C54) must not be used to insinuate anything about him. His reported claim that Anderson was not the shooter is unverified (C56).

history.detail: Pleaded no contest to voluntary manslaughter; 28 years (C57).

people.name: Sean Combs
people.role: Bad Boy Records founder; named in Davis's statements

history.detail: Davis claimed in 2008/2009 interviews that Combs offered ~$1 million (C70, DO NOT USE).
Recordings/testimony relaying Davis's claim heard at trial (C70).

matters.notes: Never charged or accused by authorities; denies Davis's claims; LVMPD reportedly said he was never a suspect (C71). DA said after the verdict there is not enough evidence to charge anyone else (C69).

matters.matter: U.S. v. Combs (S.D.N.Y.), unrelated federal case

history.detail: Convicted on Mann Act counts; acquitted of racketeering and sex trafficking (C73).
50 months (C73).

matters.notes: Unrelated. Do not place next to the Tupac allegation.
